#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class Test {
public:
    int readInt() {
        int ans = 0;
        bool neg = false;
        char c;
        while (cin.get(c)) {
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                break;
            } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                ans = c - '0';
                while (cin.get(c) && c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
                }
                if (neg) ans = -ans;
                return ans;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int r, c;
    vector<vector<long>> C;
    long bestDistance;
    vector<char> sequenceChars;
    vector<int> countA, countB;
    map<long, long> memoCache;

    long dfsSearch(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = labs(x - y);
        if (bestDistance <= 1 || diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= bestDistance) return 0;
        if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
            if (diff < bestDistance) bestDistance = diff;
            return 0;
        }
        long res = 0;
        if (v1 >= r) {
            long deltaX = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], deltaY = C[v2][r];
            res += dfsSearch(x, y + deltaX * deltaY, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= r) {
            long deltaX = C[v1][r], deltaY = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            res += dfsSearch(x + deltaX * deltaY, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    long recursiveSolve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = memoCache.find(key);
        if (it != memoCache.end()) return it->second;
        long result = 0;
        long d = labs(x - y);
        if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > bestDistance) {
            memoCache[key] = result;
            return result;
        }
        if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
            int sumIndex = v1 + v2;
            if (v1 >= countA[sumIndex] && v2 >= countB[sumIndex]) {
                v1 -= countA[sumIndex];
                v2 -= countB[sumIndex];
                result = C[v1 + v2][v1];
                memoCache[key] = result;
                return result;
            }
            memoCache[key] = result;
            return result;
        }
        char c = sequenceChars[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            result += recursiveSolve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            result += recursiveSolve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        memoCache[key] = result;
        return result;
    }

    void execute() {
        r = readInt();
        c = readInt();
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        getline(cin, line);
        sequenceChars.assign(line.begin(), line.end());

        int size = 2 * (r + c) + 1;
        C.assign(size + 1, vector<long>(size + 1, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (r + c); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }

        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        long xCoord = 0, yCoord = 0;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (xCoord > yCoord) {
                long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
                yCoord += c1 * s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                xCoord += s1 * c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        bestDistance = labs(xCoord - yCoord);
        dfsSearch(0, 0, r + c, r + c);

        int totalSize = 2 * (r + c);
        countA.assign(totalSize + 1, 0);
        countB.assign(totalSize + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
            countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (sequenceChars[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (sequenceChars[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        long answer = recursiveSolve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Test t;
    t.execute();
    return 0;
}
